name: akeyless-ara
description: Akeyless Agentic Runtime Authority (ARA) MCP server for Codex — secretless database and cloud access

interface.shortDescription: Secretless database and cloud access for Codex via Agentic Runtime Authority
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Akeyless Agentic Runtime Authority (ARA). List ARA-enabled secrets, query databases, and execute cloud/Kubernetes/GitHub/custom-MCP actions — credentials stay in Akeyless and never enter the model context. Same tool surface as akeyless mcp-runtime-authority.
defaultPrompt: List my Akeyless ARA secrets and summarize what I can access.
Run SELECT count(*) FROM users against my postgres ARA secret.
Use service-execute to list S3 buckets with my AWS ARA secret.
